{{Quote|I saw full-left-handed what this Grand Admiral Thrawn did to my world's defenses ten standardcycles ago, and with nothing more than seven Katana-fleet Dreadnoughts as his weapons.|A Senator|<ref name="Specter" />}}
A '''battle''' involving the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] took place near a [[Unidentified Sronk Senator's homeworld|world]] in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]] as a part of the [[Thrawn campaign]], with seven of the Imperial Remnant's [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Dreadnaught''-class heavy cruisers]] commanded by [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] attacking the [[planet]]'s defenses. In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], a [[Sronk]] [[Unidentified Sronk Senator|Senator]] mentioned the battle during a session of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[New Republic Senate/Legends|Senate]] concerning the alleged return of Thrawn.

==Prelude==
In [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant's]] [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] acquired the [[Katana fleet|''Katana'' fleet]] in order to expand the Imperial Remnant's [[Imperial Navy/Legends|fleet]] for the [[Thrawn campaign]].<ref name="DFR">''[[Dark Force Rising]]''</ref>

==The battle==
In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date" /> Thrawn attacked the [[Planet/Legends|world's]] defenses with the Imperial Remnant's forces, made up of seven [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Dreadnaught''-class heavy cruisers]] from the ''Katana Fleet''. The battle was witnessed by an [[Unidentified Sronk Senator|Sronk]] who went on to become a [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] in the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|Senate]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="Specter" />

==Aftermath==
Later during 9 ABY,<ref name="Date" /> Thrawn [[Death|perished]] during a [[Battle of Bilbringi (9 ABY)|battle]] at the [[Bilbringi Shipyards]].<ref name="Specter" /> In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]],<ref name="DateSotP">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Specter of the Past]]'' to [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]]</ref> the Sronk Senator was present at a session of the New Republic Senate to discuss the threat of Thrawn's alleged return. When a [[Likash]]an [[Unidentified Likashan Senator|Senator]] insisted the New Republic can overpower the Imperial Remnant and should destroy it, the Senator mentioned the battle of their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] and insisted that such attacks were doomed to fail, as Thrawn would not have announced his return if he was unprepared for the New Republic's attacks. In reality, Thrawn had not returned, and the alleged return was faked was [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Vilim Disra]] using the conman [[Flim (Human)|Flim]].<ref name="Specter" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle was mentioned in the novel ''[[Specter of the Past]]'', written by [[Timothy Zahn]] and published in [[1997]] as part one of the ''[[Star Wars: The Hand of Thrawn Duology]]''.<ref name="Specter" />
